content.title: Orlando Wrongful Death Lawyer
content.text: We understand that losing a family member in a fatal accident is devastating. The absence of your loved one can also cause financial strain for your family. Our Orlando wrongful death lawyers are dedicated to helping surviving family members secure the compensation they deserve. Since 1979, we have worked with surviving family members of accident victims, and we want to help you next. Our Central Florida law firm can file claims for your relative’s estate and family. The Orlando personal injury lawyers from Bogin, Munns & Munns will take on every aspect of your wrongful death case. Let us help you seek justice today when you call for a free consultation. How Our Attorneys Help in Orlando Wrongful Death Claims Retaining wrongful death lawyers from our firm can be helpful after an Orlando accident. We can: Assign a value for your losses: Claims in any personal injury case can be complicated, but the loss of a loved one can make it harder to determine how much you can seek. Our wrongful death attorneys will make sure every expense and loss is accounted for. We will consult experts to help calculate the damages you are entitled to, including those that do not have a direct financial value. Work to hold responsible parties accountable for your damages: We will review your case to determine which party or parties are liable for the deceased person’s death. Some cases can involve multiple people or companies who are responsible for your family’s losses. We have many years of experience in tort law, and we will make sure we properly establish negligence. Negotiate with the liable parties’ insurance companies: Insurance companies do not always cooperate or offer an adequate payout for your losses. We can handle these conversations and make your family’s best interests are represented. We may be able to come to an agreement without taking your case to court, but if insurers aren’t willing to make a fair offer, we will not hesitate to take your case to court. Answer any questions you have about your wrongful death claim: There is a lot of uncertainty about damages, who can file a claim, and what tasks you may need to do in the aftermath of your loss. We can help you with your questions and perform certain tasks on your behalf. Protect your rights: insurers may not be arguing in good faith, and we will make sure your rights and interests are protected throughout the entire process. We will make sure we take over any communications to avoid having insurers twist your words and use them against you. Take your case to court, if necessary: When settlement negotiations do not pan out, we will represent your lawsuit in court. Going to trial can seem intimidating, but we are with you every step of the way, and we handle all necessary negotiations and paperwork. You should be healing with family and friends. A wrongful death case can be a complicated process. Let our team handle the legal process for you so your family can grieve peacefully. While compensation will not bring back the deceased person, it could help you cope with the unexpected financial strain brought on by their absence. Let Bogin, Munns & Munns Help You Through Your Wrongful Death Case At Bogin, Munns & Munns, we understand that navigating the aftermath of a wrongful death is profoundly challenging. For over 40 years, we have dedicated ourselves to serving Central Florida with a commitment to treating our clients like family. When you choose us to represent your wrongful death case, you’re not just gaining legal advocates; you’re joining a family that listens, supports, and fights for you. Communication is paramount in any legal battle. Our firm ensures that you have open, easy, and fast communication with your Orlando personal injury attorneys. You will never feel out of the loop, as we believe in keeping our clients informed and involved at every step. We pride ourselves on serving a diverse clientele, adhering to our founding principles of respect, dignity, and fairness. No matter your background, our firm will provide you with innovative and comprehensive representation. We strive to make our services accessible, offering quality legal representation at a fair price. When it comes to wrongful death cases, your needs are our priority. We relentlessly pursue justice and appropriate compensation, handling each case with the utmost care and dedication. With Bogin, Munns & Munns, you can rest assured that our experienced and knowledgeable team will work tirelessly to secure the results you need. Let us take on the legal challenges, so you can focus on healing. Choose us—where your family becomes ours. To consult with an experienced wrongful death lawyer serving Orlando (855) 780-9986 Damages You Could Recover After a Wrongful Death in Orlando Every case is different, and your potential settlement or court-awarded judgment will depend on the losses your loved one’s passing has caused. You may be able to recover compensation for: Your loved one’s medical costs, including surgery, treatment, an ambulance ride, hospital stay, physical therapy, and prescriptions. We will ensure that all current and future medical expenses are accounted for, no matter how long it takes you to recover. Your loved one’s physical pain and suffering. Some victims may have survived the initial accident or injuries, but later pass away. Your loved one’s pain and suffering should be acknowledged, and we aim to make the at-fault parties pay for this loss. Your mental anguish, including emotional pain, psychological distress, and grief Funeral expenses: When your family member passes away, you are now responsible for making funeral plans. This can be an extremely costly expense, especially with all of the other unexpected expenses or monetary losses, not to mention the emotional distress you are going through. We will fight for funeral and burial expenses to help alleviate some of your financial burdens. Loss of companionship, guidance, instruction and protection: The emotional impact of your loss won’t be overlooked. You have lost a beloved family member, whether they be a spouse, parent, sibling, child, or another family who supported you, and their passing have left you with an emotional void. We may be able to seek compensation for the emotional benefits they would have provided had they not passed. Loss of your loved one’s income and future income and benefits: The economic losses associated with your loved one’s passing are not just limited to medical expenses. They may have contributed their income to your household, and not you and other surviving family members are struggling to make ends meet. We can seek lost income and lost earning potential to help keep your family afloat. We can also pursue any of your lost income if you had to take time off work to care for your loved one before their passing. You may be eligible for additional damages not listed here, it just depends on the facts of your case. Please call Bogin, Munn & Munns to discuss your losses and begin your free consultation. What to Expect from Your Orlando Wrongful Death Case Your lawyer will start by speaking with you to understand your situation. Our wrongful death attorneys take an empathetic approach, learning about your financial burdens, mental pain, and other fallout from your loss. Then, we will lay out your options, including filing an insurance claim or lawsuit. Our team will complete a thorough investigation of your loved one’s passing and the resulting damages. We will provide clear, honest advice, but you have the ultimate say over how we proceed with your case. Our legal team negotiates for a fair settlement in every Orlando wrongful death case. We can file a lawsuit against at-fault parties if this does not produce an award. Should liable parties still refuse to pay you fairly, we’re prepared to take your case to trial. You will not pay for our services upfront. Other firms might ask for a lump sum payment at the beginning or charge fees by the hour. We don’t. Bogin, Munns & Munns will only receive a fee if we get compensation for you. Legal Arguments in Orlando Wrongful Death Cases Some legal arguments we have made in wrongful death cases include: That a property owner failed to repair or remedy a hazard on the property That a negligent driver engaged in dangerous driving, such as texting and driving A pet owner failed to monitor or secure a dog A manufacturer produced a defective or improperly repaired vehicle/vehicle part A city failed to repair a defective street sign or traffic light If it applies to you, we could also make the case that the City of Orlando failed you by failing to repair defective equipment at intersections or interchanges like: I-4 and 408 Interchange Central Florida Parkway and John Young Parkway Aloma Avenue and Semoran Boulevard Unfortunately, we see clients lose loved ones under a variety of circumstances. Bogin, Munns & Munns can help if you’ve lost a loved one because of a: Car accidents, truck accidents, and motorcycle accident: Orlando is one of the largest cities in Florida, and the constant flux of tourists, community and on-campus students, new residents, and long-term residents mean many drivers are on the road. In 2023, the Florida Traffic Safety Dashboard recorded almost 22,000 crashes. Sprawling intersections, construction, and congested and confusing highways puts drivers at risk every day. When other drivers are negligent, this increases the risks for fatal injuries. Bicycle collisions and pedestrian accidents: Not only are drivers at risk on the roads, but pedestrians and bikers are even more vulnerable to negligent drivers. Some of Orlando’s roads are not designed with bikers and pedestrians in mind, and these accidents can be devastating. If a loved one passed away, from this kind of accident, you deserve justice, Boat/watercraft accident: Orlando has many beautiful lakes and waterways, but negligent boaters can cause major issues for people on the water. We can help you if your loved one died t in a watercraft accident. Defective product: Faulty and dangerous products can cause a lot of harm, and out lawyers are prepared to represent you and fight for your losses after the death of a family member. Some of the cases we handle include dangerous drugs, faulty parts, and defective products. Medical malpractice: Medical malpractice can cause major injuries that cause the death of patients. We can help you seek damages from doctors, nurses, hospitals, and other medical professionals or entities. Slip and falls and other premises liability cases: Property owners and managers have a duty to their visitors, customers, and clients. If they were somehow responsible for your loved one’s passing, we will seek damages from them. Let Bogin, Munns & Munns lead your wrongful death lawsuit. An attorney from our Orlando firm will protect your privacy while fighting for the financial recovery you’re entitled to. If your case is not listed here, don’t hesitate to reach out to see if we can help. Your Lawyer Can Establish Negligence Negligence is the basis of most personal injury cases. Securing compensation will require us to prove that: The other party had a duty of care to keep you safe The other party’s action or inaction violated the duty of care The other party’s violation caused the accident The accident caused your damages Your lawyer serving Orlando will explore all angles of your accident case. We want to secure justice for your loved one’s tragic passing. Orlando Wrongful Death Lawyer Near Me (855) 780-9986 Our Firm Is Ready to Lead Your Wrongful Death Case in Orlando We want to tackle the case for you and secure an award that brings justice to an unfair situation. We have helped other injured parties and hurt families before. Here is what some of them have had to say: “It is not often that you run into a complete stranger who is willing to help… honest, professional, and passionate attorney who is dedicated to helping you and understands your pain.” – Andrea P. “[Bogin, Munns & Munns] made me feel truly valued as a client… as the relationship by far exceeded my expectations. I highly recommend the Bogin, Munns & Munns Firm for any/all of your personal Injury legal matters. – Henry M. Your Orlando wrongful death lawyer will answer all your questions and stand by you throughout the case. How Long do I Have to Take Action in My Case? When filing an insurance claim, you must keep to the company’s deadline. However, the story is different if you decide to file a lawsuit. You generally will have two years to file this kind of legal action in Florida. Florida Statutes § 95.11 states that personal representatives of the deceased can file these lawsuits. If you fail to file the lawsuit in time, the court could throw out your case. You could lose your right to pursue compensation.
